scope: Fresh ordered replay of all current PostgreSQL schema migrations on ARM64 PostgreSQL/PostGIS under QEMU

schema_replay.runner: services.migration CLI with explicit Compose project and --schemas-only

recovery_of_initial_attempt.initial_attempt: Stopped at migration 042 with a sanitized psql failure.
recovery_of_initial_attempt.diagnostic_full_replay: A second clean replay applied all 529 migrations through 538; migration 042 and the previous migration-068 stall point passed.
recovery_of_initial_attempt.root_cause: The initial migration-042 failure was not reproduced; no SQL cause was identified.

result: PASS: all 529 current PostgreSQL schemas through migration 538 applied on an isolated linux/arm64 PostgreSQL 16/PostGIS image under QEMU, with zero failures.
limitations: QEMU replay is software compatibility evidence, not physical Raspberry Pi, thermal, power-loss, storage, or performance acceptance.
This replay exercised PostgreSQL/PostGIS migrations only; it did not start the ARM64 application stack or external providers.
No candidate migration or rollout occurred; candidate and legacy databases were not targeted.
